explication: Clash Party is an Electron Mihomo GUI. Users manage proxy profiles and routing in the renderer; requests cross the preload IPC bridge to main-process configuration and core-management services, which apply settings to Mihomo and the operating system. The README also identifies Smart Core, Tun, Sub-Store, WebDAV backup/restore, themes, and configuration overrides as product capabilities. The graph combines those documented capabilities with sampled startup, configuration, core, and IPC evidence; unsampled subsystem wiring is left out where uncertain.
